Situation Report — Iran‑Israel‑US (last 24 hours)

  • Strike/Clash: IDF reports it killed an armed Hezbollah operative after a manhunt in southern Lebanon.
  • Airspace & flights: Repeated flight scans show airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan. Scans reported zero military flights in the samples provided.
  • Israeli military movements: IDF Paratroopers Brigade conducted heavy‑equipment drill using transport aircraft into a combat zone.

  • Nuclear/site activity: Satellite imagery reportedly shows construction near an Iranian nuclear site alleged to violate an MOU.
  • Diplomacy & statements: Trump vowed calm during the funeral, said US won’t target Iran’s leadership, and hinted Netanyahu may visit the US next week. Putin expressed hope for mutually acceptable US‑Iran solutions. Turkey is hosting a NATO summit; Erdogan warned Israel not to “dynamite” a US‑Iran deal.
  • Regional incidents: Drone discovered on Turkish coast (news agency report). Israel denied reports it plotted to kill Iranian negotiators. Hamas said it will stall Gaza talks and reject concessions.
  • International defense action: Germany is accelerating a nationwide ballistic‑missile defense rollout using the Israeli Arrow system.
  • 🟢 Good News: Germany moving to accelerate deployment of the Arrow missile‑defense system for regional protection.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • איראן פנימית: הלוויות ועמדת משא ומתן המונים נושאים עיניהם להלוויות של ח'אמנאי. המתווך העליון של איראן אמר שהמדינה "מוכנה למלחמה" בעוד המשא‑ומתן מתקדם באיטיות.

  • תקריות אזוריות: דווח על רחפן שנתגלה בחוף טורקיה. ישראל הכחישה דיווחים על תכנון חיסול משא ומתני איראן. חמאס נועד לעכב את משא‑ומתן עזה ולדחות ויתורים.
